en-US.name: Ora — Live Translation
en-US.subtitle: Live captions on your Mac
en-US.promotionalText: Follow speech with bilingual captions on your Mac. Choose on-device recognition and translation, customize the caption window, and revisit your local transcript history.
en-US.description:
Follow conversations, videos, and presentations with translated captions on your Mac.

Ora lives in the menu bar and displays a floating caption window. Choose microphone audio, system audio, or both for meetings. Show the original speech with the translation, switch to translation-only captions, or choose a compact layout.

ON-DEVICE BY DEFAULT
Local Qwen speech recognition and MLX Swift translation process speech on your Apple Silicon Mac. First use downloads model files; once fully cached, the default local backends can work offline. Choose Standard, High, or Extra High translation quality to suit your Mac's resources.

A WINDOW THAT FITS
Adjust source and translation text size, choose your caption layout, and start or stop listening with a keyboard shortcut.

LOCAL HISTORY
Review recognized text and completed translations in transcript history. Export text to a location you choose, or delete saved history in Preferences. Ora does not save raw audio recordings.

OPTIONAL BACKENDS
Advanced users can connect a separately running Rapid-MLX server or configure a RealRouter API key. Ora asks before each external-service listening session and explains what is sent. External services have their own policies, availability, and usage limits. No external account is required for the default local mode.

REQUIREMENTS
Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. An internet connection and several gigabytes of free space are required to download local models initially. Larger models require additional memory and storage. Optional Apple streaming recognition requires macOS 26 or later and currently uses English input.

Translations are generated by models and may contain errors, including names, numbers, currency, and meaning. Check important details against the original speech.
en-US.whatsNew: First Mac App Store preparation: App Sandbox support, complete cached local-model startup without waiting on the network, privacy and support links, and per-session confirmation for optional external AI processing.

zh-Hans.name: Ora — 实时语音翻译
zh-Hans.subtitle: Mac 本地识别与双语字幕
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 用双语字幕跟随会议、视频和演讲。默认在 Mac 本地识别与翻译，可调整字幕样式，并在本地历史中回看内容。
zh-Hans.keywords: 语音,翻译,字幕,实时,会议,转写,离线,本地,双语,听力
zh-Hans.description:
用 Mac 上的悬浮字幕，跟随会议、视频与演讲。

Ora 常驻菜单栏，支持麦克风、系统音频或会议双输入。可同时显示原文与译文，也可切换为仅译文或紧凑布局。

默认本地处理
本地 Qwen 识别与 MLX Swift 翻译直接在 Apple Silicon Mac 上处理语音。首次使用需要下载模型；完整缓存后，默认本地模型可离线运行。可按设备资源选择 Standard、High 或 Extra High 翻译质量。

适合你的字幕窗口
调整原文与译文字号，选择显示布局，通过快捷键开始或停止监听。

本地文字历史
回看识别原文与完成的译文，将文字导出到自行选择的位置，或在设置中删除历史。Ora 不保存原始录音。

可选外部服务
高级用户可连接单独运行的 Rapid-MLX 服务，或配置 RealRouter API 密钥。每次使用外部服务开始监听前，Ora 会说明发送的数据并征求同意。外部服务遵循其各自的隐私政策、可用性和用量限制。默认本地模式无需外部账号。

运行要求
需要 Apple Silicon Mac 与 macOS 15 或更新版本。首次下载本地模型需要网络和数 GB 可用空间；更大的模型需要更多内存与存储。可选 Apple 流式识别需要 macOS 26 或更新版本，当前使用英文输入。

模型生成的字幕可能在姓名、数字、币种和语义上出错。重要信息请核对原始发言。
zh-Hans.whatsNew: 首次准备 Mac App Store 构建：支持应用沙盒，修复完整模型缓存仍等待网络的问题，加入隐私及支持入口，并为可选的外部 AI 处理增加每次会话确认。
